name: Freelancer Keep Weapons
description: Copy owned gear from the Freelancer safehouse wall while leaving the original in place.

options.name: Spawn copy of owned wall item (experimental)
options.tooltip: Use the gear-wall action to copy an owned, placed item. Press P to take the original; Default Keybinds swaps these actions. Already-carried ordinary gear cannot be copied. Requires ZHM Mod SDK 4.1.1 core and the included helper.

options.name: Default Keybinds
options.tooltip: When enabled, the normal wall Take/Enter action takes the original. Press P to copy it instead.

options.name: Hide notifications
options.tooltip: Hide wall-copy status messages. Copying and taking are unaffected.

options.name: Hide P key hint
options.tooltip: Hide the P shortcut from the gear-wall prompt. The P shortcut still works.

options.name: Wall copy default-keybind marker
options.condition: "Spawn copy of owned wall item (experimental)" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and "Default Keybinds" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions)

options.name: Wall copy hide-notifications marker
options.condition: "Spawn copy of owned wall item (experimental)" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and "Hide notifications" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions)

options.name: Wall copy label - copy only
options.condition: "Spawn copy of owned wall item (experimental)" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and "Hide P key hint" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and not ("Default Keybinds" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions))

options.name: Wall copy label - original with P copy
options.condition: "Spawn copy of owned wall item (experimental)" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and "Default Keybinds" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and not ("Hide P key hint" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions))

options.name: Wall copy label - original only
options.condition: "Spawn copy of owned wall item (experimental)" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and "Default Keybinds" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions) and "Hide P key hint" in ('LeadingTiger9.FreelancerKeepWeapons' of config.modOptions)
